newsitem.title: USA: Waxman may monetize part of Barnett stake.
newsitem.headline: Waxman may monetize part of Barnett stake.

text.p: Waxman Industries Inc said Wednesday it continues to evaluate opportunities to further reduce its debt, including the monetization of a portion of its interest in Barnett Inc.
"One way for us to reduce our indebtedness would be to sell additional Barnett shares," said Waxman Vice President of Finance Mark Wester.

Net sales reported by Barnett, in which Waxman has a 54 percent economic interest, amounted to $39.9 million for the second quarter of fiscal 1997, or an increase of 28.2 percent over the second quarter of fiscal 1996, Waxman said.
The company said Barnett's increase is attributed to continued expansion and development of its telesales operations and new product introductions.
